title: 달력 읽기: 오늘은 몇 월 며칠, 무슨 요일이에요?
objective: By the end, you can look at a Korean calendar and say any date as '○월 ○일 ○요일이에요', using 유월 and 시월 correctly. You can also answer '며칠이에요?' and '무슨 요일이에요?' and spell 며칠 / correctly.
summary: Learn to read a Korean calendar and say the month, the date, and the day of the week.

task.title: READ AND SAY DATES
task.line: Write each answer in Korean, and write numbers in Hangeul when the question asks you to.

sections.heading: 2 / HOW TO SAY A DATE: MONTH → DAY → DAY OF THE WEEK
3 / TIPS: NUMBERS AND QUESTIONS
paragraphs: Use Sino-Korean numbers (일, 이, 삼, 사…). Months: 일월, 이월, 삼월, 사월, 오월, 유월, 칠월, 팔월, 구월, 시월, 십일월, 십이월. Two months drop a sound: 6월 is 유월 (yuwol), not 육월, and 10월 is 시월 (siwol), not 십월. Days do not change: 6일 is 육일 and 10일 is 십일.
To ask the date, say 며칠이에요? (myeochil). Always write 며칠, never 몇일. To ask the day of the week, say 무슨 요일이에요? For the full date, ask 오늘이 몇 월 며칠이에요?
Many Korean wall calendars start the week on Sunday and show Sundays and public holidays in red.

exercises: Write the month in Hangeul: ①6월 ②10월 ③3월
Choose the correct word: ①약속이 (몇일 / 며칠)이에요? ②파티가 (무슨 / 며칠) 요일이에요?
Read the note and answer in a full sentence. 11월 1일은 일요일이에요. ①11월 3일은 무슨 요일이에요? ②11월 7일은 무슨 요일이에요?
Write this date in Hangeul the way you say it: 10월 16일 목요일
The exam is on June 24. Answer the question in a full sentence, writing the numbers in Hangeul: 시험이 며칠이에요?
Find and fix the two mistakes: 오늘이 육월 몇일이에요?
answers: ① 유월 ② 시월 ③ 삼월
